title: CAD/BIM exact-version licensing/composition evidence (web + Electron/desktop)
objective: Produce exact-version licensing/composition EVIDENCE for the CAD/BIM stack actually tested across RESEARCH-CAD-001..005 (IfcOpenShell 0.8.5, OCCT 7.8.1 via cadquery-ocp 7.8.1.1.post1, cadquery 2.6.1, ezdxf 1.4.3, numpy 2.1.3, FreeCAD 1.1.3 AppImage, Python 3.12.13), covering BOTH the web deployment model and the Electron/desktop deployment model. Record each component's exact version from authoritative pinned sources, identify each license from stable upstream facts, raise composition flags for LICENSE-001, and analyse both deployment models' LGPL posture. This gate does NOT approve any composition, change production packaging, or alter Architecture v1.1; it produces the inventory and flags that feed LICENSE-001.
acceptance_criteria: The exact version of every tested component is recorded from authoritative pinned sources and cross-checked against importable distribution metadata where present.
Every tested component license is identified from a stable upstream statement and SPDX-classified.
A complete composition flag matrix exists for LICENSE-001; no composition is approved by this gate.
Web deployment is analysed, including the tested server-side path and explicit WASM-not-tested status.
Electron/desktop deployment is analysed, including the native-worker path and LGPL posture.
The frozen v1.1 adapter boundary is identified as the mechanism preserving user replacement rights for copyleft components.
No GPL strong-copyleft component is present in the tested stack.
Results support, reject, or defer the licensing/composition posture; LICENSE-001 makes the final decision.
non_goals: No re-measurement of CAD/BIM capability or performance.
risk_assumptions: POST-MERGE VERIFICATION: all five dependencies are VERIFIED; RESEARCH-CAD-006 merged to main at 74f95529f20a0840f6e1189a37e3b9a3d9c8c34f. Governance run 32997108160 (#67) and research-cad-006 run 32997108095 (#3) both completed successfully on that exact merge revision.
SPEC DIVERGENCE: spec/work-items.md retains the older performance/file-size definition; Issue #6 is authoritative for this work item.
Architecture version: v1.1 active and frozen; the older spec header is superseded by the ACR-002 topology decision.
Records/inventory only: versions and licenses come from authoritative committed sources; unavailable distributions are recorded honestly.
WASM not tested: the tested Web path is server-side only; any distributable WASM composition requires LICENSE-001 review.
Final-proof boundary: adapter replacement plus existential end-to-end workflow is CAD-007 scope.
evidence_requirements: Composition flag matrix complete; no approval.
Adapter boundary identified as replacement mechanism.
